headline: Fuel Truck Jams Reported Near Irapuato Following Pemex Pipeline Closures
summary: Fuel tanker trucks jammed a highway near Irapuato following pipeline closures by Pemex, while officials reported no official comment from the state oil company.
why: Logistical disruptions in fuel transportation can impact regional energy supply chains, distribution costs, and industrial operations.

impacts.name: Energy Infrastructure
impacts.why: Pipeline closures disrupt local fuel transport and distribution logistics.
